title: 彭博航天主编：SpaceX为何此时IPO？星链盈利与垄断地位
speaker: Benedict Campbell

segments.en: Starlink yeah what do we know what becomes of that 75 billion dollars why the company is doing this and needs to do it right now.
segments.zh: 星链呢？这750亿美元将用于何处？公司为何现在需要上市？

segments.en: Well the company has one business that is extremely cash thirsty and that is the AI operations X AI but also rockets are obviously something that is expensive so the company needs the cash it feels like now is a good moment they stabilize the operation in terms of the space operation that Starlink is doing extremely well they keep signing up customers particularly in the aviation space.
segments.zh: 公司有一项极其耗钱的业务：AI运营X AI，火箭也很昂贵。现在时机不错，太空运营稳定，星链表现极佳，尤其在航空领域不断签约客户。

segments.en: So that it feels like now is the kind of moment and if you look at the flip side they always have a monopoly if you look at what's going on with other rocket launch as we only see a couple of or the explosion on the new Glenn that's the that's sort of the rival product so that really sort of cemented in a slightly tragic way even though nobody was hurt or killed even but it cemented Starlink's and space X dominance in this in this sphere they are really the only game in town and I think is a lot.
segments.zh: 现在正是时机。另一方面，他们拥有垄断地位，其他火箭发射寥寥无几，新格伦火箭爆炸更巩固了星链和SpaceX的主导地位，他们是市场上唯一的选择。
